metadata.title: हेमंत सोरेन की वापसी | मध्य प्रदेश और राजस्थान में आदिवासी गर्जना | Weekly Tribal Roundup
metadata.description: Chattisgarh Naxal Encounter, Hemant Soren took oath as the Chief Minister of Jharkhand. Selana MLA Kameshwar Dodiyar spoke in the assembly about the poor conditions of schools in tribal areas. TIPRA Motha Chief Pradyot Manikya Debbarma met Tribal Affairs Minister Jual Oram in Delhi.
